summary: Comprehensive testing of Beautify Yourself & Beyond wellness app completed. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests PASSED including all CRUD endpoints (mood, journal, notes, tasks, affirmations, feedback, declutter, stats) and AI SSE streaming (/api/ai/reset with Claude Sonnet 4.6). Frontend: All 8 feature pages render and navigate correctly; home shows all cards with correct branding. Fixed one blocking typo in reset.tsx that broke AI stream parsing (chunk.split('\\n') -> chunk.split('\n')); after fix, AI card streams personalized somatic guidance beautifully. Minor React Native console warnings observed (see below) but non-blocking. Backend success: 100%, Frontend success: ~95% (all core flows work).

ui_bugs.issue: SSE stream parsing typo: chunk.split('\\n') split on literal string \\n instead of newline, so AI card never appeared. FIXED by testing agent. Reference: /app/frontend/app/reset.tsx:69

issues: The ℠ superscript character renders on a second line next to 'Boss Mode Planner' making the header title look broken/wrapped. Consider replacing with a smaller <Text> element with fontSize superscript style or removing.

Screen headers (Stack.Screen title) with ℠ show 'SM' as separate visual element on some screens (e.g., 'Daily Affirmations℠'). Recommend using a custom header component with proper superscript styling.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error repeated on every screen: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Likely a stray whitespace/text between JSX elements inside a <View> (possibly in _layout.tsx or a shared component). Not visually broken but pollutes console and can break native builds. Reference: search for whitespace/comments between sibling JSX inside <View>.

Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from a library (likely gesture-handler or safe-area-context). Non-blocking but worth tracking library upgrades.

action_items: Investigate and fix the 'Unexpected text node' warning by finding stray whitespace/text between JSX elements inside <View> across screens (produces console error on every screen).

Improve rendering of the ℠ service-mark on titles (e.g., Boss Mode Planner℠, Daily Affirmations℠) — currently visually wraps as separate 'SM' element. Consider custom Text component with superscript styling.
Optional: The static reset card (RESET_CARDS) and AI card both display — consider using AI card only or clarifying their purpose to avoid duplication.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly with /api prefix. Good.
Backend endpoints correctly excluded MongoDB _id via Pydantic model_dump. All responses serialize cleanly.
AI endpoint returns SSE with proper Content-Type text/event-stream and includes X-Accel-Buffering:no for Nginx passthrough. Streaming works end-to-end.
reset.tsx: original client parser split on '\\n' (literal), missed newlines. Fixed.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed data in mood, journal, notes, tasks, affirmations, feedback collections via pytest lifecycle. A couple of leftover TEST entries (mood 'TEST_calm', a feedback 'TEST_feedback message', 'Test task', 'Test entry', 'Test note') exist from earlier UI interaction; safe to leave or clean via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs at https://beautify-yourself.preview.emergentagent.com/api. All CRUD endpoints and AI SSE stream validated. Frontend Expo web preview loads all 8 pages; navigation via expo-router Stack works. AI reset card streaming now works after fixing split('\\n') -> split('\n') on frontend reset.tsx. Console has non-blocking 'Unexpected text node' warnings that main agent should hunt down (probably stray whitespace between JSX siblings within a <View>).
rca_of_issue: AI stream card missing: reset.tsx line 69 split on literal string '\\n' (double-escaped in source), never producing multiple lines from SSE payload. The 'data: ...' line detection therefore always failed and setAiCard was never called with content. Fix: change split('\\n') to split('\n'). Verified: AI card now streams and renders full personalized somatic guidance.
